name: ~Uzy~
source:
In this story, you will have to take responsibility for a young widow, Destiny Sarah Abscond, who is haunted by the Shadow of her dead husband.

Based on the comic project "Wasteland" by [url=http://lolmilkmaria.deviantart.com/]LolMilkMaria[/url].
translation:
在这个故事中，你必须对一位年轻的寡妇命运莎拉潜逃负责，她被死去丈夫的阴影所困扰。

基于 [url=http://lolmilkmaria.deviantart.com/]LolMilkMaria[/url] 的漫画项目“Wasteland”。
